evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Directive establishes a recurring future cadence and frames an irrealis conditional principle about unrehearsed rollbacks at an abstract categorical level.
Assertive label names a specific planned recurring event — future-irrealis attention tied to a concrete named artifact and cadence.
Commissive assignment names a specific person as current owner — present-realis attention on a settled, concrete role.
